checks.reason: the set with checks off (L2) beats it without (L1) on interp, JIT and AOT (addendum 19 point 6)

first_member.reason: readable's: reinterpret does not compile on Lua even with checks off (error[31004] cast requires unsafe at [c_macro] fold sites such as obj2gco)

fn_macros.reason: faster on the JIT: macro expansions spelled at each site

forms_off.reason: faster on the JIT: the three readability forms spelled as before

inline_helpers.reason: faster on the JIT: pure static helpers spelled at the call site

jit_whole_program.reason: readable's: the other value is slower or within noise on the JIT
jit_whole_program.numbers: batch 1, TIMING-add38-b1, JIT, 7 samples: the other value 2.372

layout.reason: faster on the JIT: the cycles cut by late binding on cold edges

loops.reason: readable's: the other value is slower or within noise on the JIT
loops.numbers: batch 1, TIMING-add38-b1, JIT, 7 samples: the other value 1.017

param_writes.reason: readable's: not searched (copy is an interpreter-only knob; the JIT lane chooses)

past_end.reason: readable's: not searched (addendum 38's knob list leaves it out; an interpreter knob, the JIT inlines end_index)

solid_context.reason: readable's: every converted module keeps it (a global or function reached by index)

strict_aliasing.reason: faster on the JIT: Lua is clean under -fstrict-aliasing, so the TBAA classes apply (suite, error checks and luac pass)

switch_dispatch.reason: faster on every tier: the dense switches (lvm's dispatch among them) one jump each

speed.over: the in-process work time over native's (clang -O3 -w -funsigned-char), geometric mean over fib, binary_trees, nbody and spectral_norm (bench/timed.lua, median of 5 runs, interp 3); the test suite is not in this search's ratio
speed.command: heavy --exclusive --label TIMING-add38-b2 --max 8G -- /root/notes/parallel/add38/cap2.sh (ab2.sh b2 5, the interpreter 3 samples)

results.notes: the set over readable on the same tier: interp 0.561, jit 0.734, exe 0.828, aot 0.818 (batch 2); jit_whole_program stays on (off measured 2.372 on the JIT); the exe tier's best set is L1 (checks safe, 0.800); the test suite, the error checks and luac -o pass under interp and JIT
